{"pattern_id": "P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "decision": "APPLY", "rationale": "Add an explicit actions/cache@v4 step for Gradle dependency caches (~/.gradle/caches) keyed by runner OS and hash of all Gradle build files and wrapper properties. This follows the pattern's mechanism of caching dependency download state with exact keys and no broad restore fallbacks, while preserving all existing steps (checkout, setup-gradle, build, artifact upload). The setup-gradle action already provides some caching, but the pattern requires implementing the cache mechanism directly.", "workflow_yaml": "name: Road Runner CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "master", "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "master", "main" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

defaults:
  run:
    working-directory: road-runner

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repo
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Setup Gradle
      uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
      with:
        validate-wrappers: true
    - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.gradle/caches
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}
    - name: Build with Gradle
      run: ./gradlew build

    - name: Store test reports
      if: failure()
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: Test reports
        path: |
          **/build/reports/
          **/build/test-results/
"}
